front: In AWS, a database password must rotate automatically on a schedule with the LEAST operational overhead. Which service stores the secret?
back: AWS Secrets Manager, with automatic rotation.
extra: Credential rotation in Secrets Manager: [Automatic, with native database integrations](../facts/parameter-store.md#parameter-store-vs-secrets-manager-rotation-row).

front: In AWS Certificate Manager (ACM), can an Amazon CloudFront distribution use a certificate that you requested in US West (Oregon)?
back: No. CloudFront uses certificates in US East (N. Virginia).
extra: You request or import the certificate for CloudFront in [US East (N. Virginia)](../facts/acm.md#acm-cloudfront-us-east-1).

front: In AWS Certificate Manager (ACM), does managed renewal cover a certificate that you imported?
back: No. You renew it and reimport it.
extra: ACM [does not manage the renewal process](../facts/acm.md#acm-faq-imported-no-managed-renewal) for imported certificates. A reimport keeps the [Amazon Resource name (ARN)](../facts/acm.md#acm-reimport-keeps-arn).
